response.title: where can i buy the Arenti AInanny B2 Baby Monitor and how much does it cost
response.answer:
You can buy the Arenti AInanny B2 Baby Monitor directly from Arenti's official US store. Prices vary depending on whether you want one or two cameras.

Where to buy and prices

AInanny B2 — 1 Camera + 1 Screen

$69.99

Arenti official store · Advertised sale price

Best for monitoring one baby or one room.

Buy from Arenti

AInanny B2 — 2 Cameras + 1 Screen

$119.99

Arenti official store · Advertised sale price

Includes split-screen monitoring for two rooms.

Buy from Arenti

AInanny B2 — 2-Camera Bundle

$139.99

Arenti official store · Advertised sale price

Two cameras, one screen, 128GB SD card and mounting bracket.

View bundle
Other retailers

Arenti AInanny at Home Depot

$99.98

Advertised sale price

Home Depot lists an Arenti AInanny monitor, but the listing does not clearly identify it as the B2 version. Confirm the model before purchasing.

View at Home Depot

Arenti also advertises free shipping to the contiguous United States and a 30-day return policy for purchases from its official website. 
Arenti® North America

My recommendation: If you need the B2 specifically, buy directly from Arenti. The $69.99 single-camera kit is the lowest advertised price I found, while the $119.99 two-camera kit is better suited to monitoring two rooms.

Prices are advertised online and may change at checkout.
